settings.content: Share Your #ifacehandmade Statues And Get A Free Extended Warranty!

settings.title: Snap a Photo of Your Statue
settings.content: Take a beautiful photo of your handmade statue to showcase your own unique sculpture.

settings.title: Post on Social Media with #ifacehandmade
settings.content: Share your photo on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, or Reddit, and use the hashtag #ifacehandmade to let others admire your adorable sculpture.

settings.title: Submit Link for Warranty Claim
settings.content: When claiming your extended warranty, simply send us a message via the social media where you contacted earlier or an email(support@ifaceusa.com) with the link to your social media post as proof. Then, enjoy the 5-year added security and peace of mind with your free extended warranty.

settings.title: What is the Extended Warranty Program?
settings.content: Our Extended Warranty Program rewards customers who share their IFACE statues on social media with a free extended warranty. To participate, post a photo or video of your statue on one of the mentioned social media platforms using the hashtag #ifacehandmade within 30 days of receiving the product.

settings.title: Which social media platforms can I post on to qualify for the extended warranty?
settings.content: You can post your statues on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter, or Reddit. Be sure to use the hashtag #ifacehandmade and set the post to public so we can find and verify it.

settings.title: How do I claim my extended warranty?
settings.content: If you ever need to claim your extended warranty outside the normal coverage period, just provide the link to your qualifying social media post when you reach out to us. We’ll verify the post and, if it meets the requirements, we’ll gladly extend your warranty. If you don’t need to make a claim, there’s no need to do anything else! *Simply share your post and enjoy peace of mind for 5 years.

settings.title: What does the extended warranty cover?
settings.content: Anything! We’re here to help you with any issues that may arise with your statue! Our main goal is to ensure you’re happy with the product . Please note that shipping fees may apply for certain services. Just reach out to us, and we’ll do our best to work together and find the best solution for you.

1. The extended warranty is valid for customers who share a public post with their statues on social media with the hashtag #ifacehandmade within 30 days of receiving the products.
  2. The post must be public and visible to us for verification purposes.
  3. The extended warranty duration is 5 years from the date of delivery.
